title: Opening logo reveal

location.extent: Opening film; PNG extracted at 1 second

slide_intent: Make an identity resolve through movement so the viewer can follow change toward a familiar sign.
strategic_value: A green 4 that assembles within changing gradient rooms can connect expressive transitions to Channel 4 recognition.
demonstration: The short film assembles separated green blocks into the 4 as warm rooms shift through pink, purple and blue before resolving on black.
practical_value: Compare the transitional fragments with the final stable silhouette.

content_islands.name: Moving blocks
content_islands.spec: Keep the green pieces at the visual center as their faces rotate into the recognizable mark.

content_islands.name: Gradient room
content_islands.spec: Surround the mark with a receding room that shifts color before fading to black.

reference_purposes.Expression: The film combines a segmented green mark, spatial gradients and a final black field.
reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram explains that the new logo reveal and singular masterbrand color support attribution outside Channel 4 platforms.
